name: Adventure Field™ 4
detailed_description:
The Premise :

Several years after Atoa defeated his evil self. Eras and Marok took the place as leader of Sarook. Atoa defeated the evil that was born from him but a greater danger was looking upon Sarook kingdom... The great dragon wars. Years later, King Eras son Edrian is convoced to the castle. A great adventure is about to unfold...

The Game :

This game is a more or less 20 hours semi open-world turn-based JRPG made with the Smile Game Builder engine. It is the direct sequel to Adventure Field™ 3... In this game you will have to fight your way trough dungeons and powerful enemies to try gathering souls gems. Between the fighting and the exploration, you can cook, grow some vegetables, discover hidden mysteries hidden behind the night and day system made especially for this game, try to find what people need to finish side quests and find many collectibles...

Free loot boxes for everyone :

In Adventure Field™ 4 you can forget the old way of getting golds and items. You will need to find a variety of chest to open at your local chest opener! You will have to open a lot of them to acquire all the 25 achievements available in the game!

Game Mechanics :

Having some difficulty with a particular enemies in combat? Ask your royal guard team mate Eserod! He will tell you about monsters strengths and weakness! You will need his help for sure! Want even more gold and items? Hire a mercenary in one of the 3 main cities to follow you on your journey and use their steal skills to rob your enemies! So to make it short...


Dark hours are coming again to Sarook Kingdom...
The Kingdom can feel the burning souls of the calamity...
The Kingdom will fall again...
But not if you save it...



We strongly recommend to play the game with a controller due to the frequent use of the camera. It is possible to play with the keyboard but it is not recommended. To rotate the camera from left to right with the keyboard use the ( Q and E keys ), from down to up use the ( F and R keys )... To zoom and unzoom the camera use the ( C and V keys ) and finally to reset the camera use the ( K key )...



The game as been made entirely with the Smile Game Builder engine and as not been exported to Unity to customize it in any way! So this game is an example of what you can do with the SGB engine without any knowledge of programmation whatsoever! Keep in mind when playing that this engine as some limitation...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760 (4 * 2800) or equivalent / AMD Athlon II X4 645 AM3 (4 * 3100) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6670, GeForce GTX 200 series with at least 1GB
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Performance is not guaranteed under a virtual or emulated environment.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 32/64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent / AMD FX-6350 (6 * 3900) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660 (2048 MB) / Radeon HD 7970 (3072 MB)
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c sound device
  • Additional Notes: Performance is not guaranteed under a virtual or emulated environment.
